message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Seven confirmed vulnerabilities were newly published in the official CVE List during the last 24 hours, all affecting monitored Microsoft Edge products. Two are high-severity remote code execution issues; immediate review of Edge update status is recommended.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based)
- Issue: CVE-2026-66318 — Information disclosure
- Severity: High (CVSS 8.1)
- Description: An origin-validation error can allow an unauthorized remote attacker to disclose information.
- Relevance: The affected product is explicitly Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), which is on the monitored list.
- Source: [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-66318)

**Finding 2**

- Product: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based)
- Issue: CVE-2026-66321 — Remote code execution
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.4)
- Description: A type-confusion flaw can allow an unauthorized remote attacker to execute code.
- Relevance: The affected product is explicitly Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), which is on the monitored list.
- Source: [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-66321)

**Finding 3**

- Product: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based)
- Issue: CVE-2026-66315 — Remote code execution
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.5)
- Description: A use-after-free flaw can allow an unauthorized remote attacker to execute code.
- Relevance: The affected product is explicitly Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), which is on the monitored list.
- Source: [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-66315)

**Finding 4**

- Product: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based)
- Issue: CVE-2026-66314 — Information disclosure
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: A time-of-check/time-of-use race condition can allow an unauthorized remote attacker to disclose information.
- Relevance: The affected product is explicitly Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), which is on the monitored list.
- Source: [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-66314)

**Finding 5**

- Product: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based)
- Issue: CVE-2026-66325 — Spoofing
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.1)
- Description: A server-side request forgery flaw can allow an unauthorized remote attacker to perform spoofing.
- Relevance: The affected product is explicitly Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), which is on the monitored list.
- Source: [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-66325)

**Finding 6**

- Product: Microsoft Edge for Android
- Issue: CVE-2026-66310 — Information disclosure
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.7)
- Description: External control of a file name or path can allow an unauthorized attacker to disclose information locally.
- Relevance: Edge for Android is part of the monitored Microsoft Edge product family.
- Source: [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-66310)

**Finding 7**

- Product: Microsoft Edge for Android
- Issue: CVE-2026-65802 — Information disclosure
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.4)
- Description: External control of a file name or path can allow an unauthorized attacker to disclose information over a network.
- Relevance: Edge for Android is part of the monitored Microsoft Edge product family.
- Source: [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-65802)

No other monitored product had a confirmed, newly published vulnerability match in the monitoring window. Because the digest includes two high-severity Edge remote code execution issues, immediate review of deployed Edge versions and available Microsoft updates is recommended.
